mkdirSync(output, { recursive: true })
const transient = error => { throw Object.assign(error, { exitCode: 75 }) }
let browser
try {
  browser = await chromium.launch({ ...config.browser.launchOptions, timeout: 30000 }).catch(transient)
  for (const [name, width, height] of [['desktop', 1440, 900], ['mobile', 390, 844]]) {
    const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width, height } }).catch(transient)
    page.setDefaultTimeout(30000)
    const failures = []
    page.on('pageerror', error => { console.error(error.message); failures.push(error.message) })
    page.on('response', response => { if (response.status() >= 400 && new URL(response.url()).origin === new URL(url).origin) failures.push(`HTTP ${response.status()}: ${response.url()}`) })
    const response = await page.goto(url, { waitUntil: 'load', timeout: 45000 }).catch(transient)
    if (!response?.ok()) throw Object.assign(new Error(`HTTP ${response?.status()} loading preview`), { exitCode: !response || [408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504].includes(response.status()) ? 75 : 1 })
    await page.locator(process.env.CAPTURE_READY_SELECTOR || 'body').waitFor({ state: 'visible' })
    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.fonts.status === 'loaded')
    const start = await startForCapture(page, {
      enabled: process.env.CAPTURE_AUTO_START !== 'false',
      selector: process.env.CAPTURE_START_SELECTOR || ''
    })
    console.log(`Capture ${name}: auto-start ${start.clicked ? 'clicked' : start.reason}`)
    await page.waitForTimeout(1000)
    await page.screenshot({ path: join(output, `final-${name}.png`), timeout: 30000 }).catch(error => {
      if (error.name === 'TimeoutError' || !browser.isConnected()) transient(error)
      throw error
    })
    if (process.env.CAPTURE_STRICT === '1' && failures.length) throw new Error(`Published build failed: ${failures.join('; ')}`)
    await page.close()
  }
} catch (error) { console.error(error); process.exitCode = error.exitCode || 1 }
finally { await browser?.close().catch(error => { console.error(error); process.exitCode ||= 75 }) }

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build "Borrowed Seconds", an original playable browser combat game from the user's pitch: "A combat game where you can manipulate time, but every second you steal creates consequences in the future."

## Requirements
- Playable in Chrome via the static preview on port 3000; no external assets or network dependencies.
- Must support desktop and mobile/touch, responsive to 1440×900 and 390×844.
- The harness auto-clicks a visible button named exactly "Play" and screenshots 1s later, so gameplay must look good quickly.
- Avoid page errors and HTTP ≥400 responses.

## Decisions
- Twin-stick arena survival game: hold Shift/Time button to slow the world and overclock shots; every stolen second creates a debt mote with a 9s fuse; matured motes spawn red "collector" enemies.
- Run structure: 4 normal waves (16s each), then a boss, "The Auditor", at wave 5; defeat = victory screen.
- Pure Canvas 2D + DOM HUD, synthesized WebAudio, no build step.
- Added test hooks at `window.__BORROWED` exposing game/app/renderer and helpers (`start`, `borrow`, `boss`, `win`, `hurt`, `setWave`, etc.).

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html`, `styles.css`, `js/main.js`, `js/game.js`, `js/ui.js`, `js/renderer.js`, `js/audio.js`.
- Implemented player movement, mouse/touch aiming, firing, blink dash, time slow/overdrive, debt motes, collectors, waves, boss phases, particles, rings, screen shake, slow-mo effects, title/pause/victory/death overlays, HUD/timeline, best-score persistence.
- Desktop and mobile title screenshots look good; gameplay loop, combat, slow-mo, boss, mobile touch controls all work in tests.
- Playwright functional test passed 15/18 checks; failures were caused by game timers running slower than wall-clock at ~15fps in software rendering, not logic errors.
- Started optimization: added backdrop and arena static caching in `renderer.js` (`buildCaches`, `buildBackdropCache`, `buildArenaCache`) but **the new cache methods are not yet wired into `drawBackdrop`/`drawArena`**.

### Active
- Replace the per-frame heavy `drawBackdrop`/`drawArena` rendering with the cached backdrop/arena plus cheap dynamic layers, to reach ≥30fps under software rendering.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Refactor `drawBackdrop(game, dt)` to `drawImage(this.backdropCache, 0, 0, w, h)` plus only a small animated overlay, and replace `drawArena` to draw `this.arenaCache.canvas` at `-extent/2, -extent/2, extent, extent` plus dynamic rim/pressure/clock-hand/echo-ring layers.
2. Re-run `/tmp/opencode/perf.mjs` and confirm fps improves from ~15 toward 40–60 at 1440×900.
3. Re-run `/tmp/opencode/test-game.mjs`; ensure debt collectors mature within 9s of game time and victory/death overlays appear within expected waits. If fps remains low, add split real-time timers or raise the dt clamp from 0.05 to ~0.06–0.08.
4. Take fresh desktop/mobile screenshots (`playwright-cli screenshot`) and inspect visuals; adjust arena brightness, initial spawn shoehorning, HUD spacing, and mobile title/game fit as needed.
5. Verify the official capture path with `start.sh`/auto-start at 1s, confirm no console/HTTP errors, and clean up test artifacts or temporary debug hooks if desired.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/renderer.js`: largest active edit; cached rendering still needs wiring.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/main.js`: input/state loop, Play/restart/pause wiring, test hooks.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/game.js`: simulation, debt/collectors, waves, boss, combat balance.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/ui.js`: HUD, timeline motes, overlays, toasts/banners.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/audio.js`: synthesized SFX/music.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: DOM structure and title HUD markup.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`: responsive HUD/title/touch/modal styling.
- `/tmp/opencode/test-game.mjs`: functional test; 15/18 passed, failures understood as slow-frame timers.
- `/tmp/opencode/perf.mjs`: fps diagnostic; baseline ~15fps, no backdrop ~38fps, no arena ~56fps.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/`: title, gameplay, combat, slow, collectors, boss, victory, death, mobile screenshots for visual review.

## Important Context
- Server runs in tmux session `game` on port 3000: `RUNTIME_DIR=/home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-runtime PORT=3000 bash start.sh`.
- `playwright-cli` initially failed because it expected `chromium-1243`; fixed with symlink `~/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1243 -> chromium-1248`. Browser config uses headed Chromium + Xvfb/SwiftShader.
- Test failure details: debt check after ~10.4s wall showed `stolen:2.1, debt:2, collectors:0`; victory check after 3.5s still `playing`. Cause is renderer running ~15fps with dt clamped to 0.05, so game time advances at ~0.75× wall speed and timers lag.
- Initial capture at 1s now uses `spawnT: 0.12 + index*0.06` for three husks, so they should be visible; earlier portals-only screenshot used 0.75s spawn delay.
- `app.input = input` was added so renderer can draw active touch sticks.
- All changes are uncommitted.

import { startForCapture } from './capture-start.mjs'
import captures from './wip-screenshots.cjs'
import { createRequire } from 'node:module'
import { readFileSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'
const runtime = join(process.env.HOME, '.local/share/omgithub-playwright')
const require = createRequire(join(runtime, 'package.json'))
const { chromium } = require('playwright')
captures.instrument({ chromium })
const config = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(runtime, process.platform === 'darwin' ? 'metal.json' : 'linux.json'), 'utf8'))
if (process.platform === 'linux') process.env.DISPLAY ||= ':' + readFileSync(join(runtime, 'display'), 'utf8').trim()
const url = process.env.CAPTURE_URL, output = process.env.CAPTURE_DIR
if (!url || !output) throw new Error('Set CAPTURE_URL and CAPTURE_DIR.')
mkdirSync(output, { recursive: true })
const transient = error => { throw Object.assign(error, { exitCode: 75 }) }
let browser
try {
  browser = await chromium.launch({ ...config.browser.launchOptions, timeout: 30000 }).catch(transient)
  for (const [name, width, height] of [['desktop', 1440, 900], ['mobile', 390, 844]]) {
    const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width, height } }).catch(transient)
    page.setDefaultTimeout(30000)
    const failures = []
    page.on('pageerror', error => { console.error(error.message); failures.push(error.message) })
    page.on('response', response => { if (response.status() >= 400 && new URL(response.url()).origin === new URL(url).origin) failures.push(`HTTP ${response.status()}: ${response.url()}`) })
    const response = await page.goto(url, { waitUntil: 'load', timeout: 45000 }).catch(transient)
    if (!response?.ok()) throw Object.assign(new Error(`HTTP ${response?.status()} loading preview`), { exitCode: !response || [408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504].includes(response.status()) ? 75 : 1 })
    await page.locator(process.env.CAPTURE_READY_SELECTOR || 'body').waitFor({ state: 'visible' })
    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.fonts.status === 'loaded')
    const start = await startForCapture(page, {
      enabled: process.env.CAPTURE_AUTO_START !== 'false',
      selector: process.env.CAPTURE_START_SELECTOR || ''
    })
    console.log(`Capture ${name}: auto-start ${start.clicked ? 'clicked' : start.reason}`)
    await page.waitForTimeout(1000)
    await page.screenshot({ path: join(output, `final-${name}.png`), timeout: 30000 }).catch(error => {
      if (error.name === 'TimeoutError' || !browser.isConnected()) transient(error)
      throw error
    })
    if (process.env.CAPTURE_STRICT === '1' && failures.length) throw new Error(`Published build failed: ${failures.join('; ')}`)
    await page.close()
  }
} catch (error) { console.error(error); process.exitCode = error.exitCode || 1 }
finally { await browser?.close().catch(error => { console.error(error); process.exitCode ||= 75 }) }
